name: health.heart_rate.action_id
scope: all invocations of the common heart-rate action callback, including its main, settings and other views; exact caller filter, no page-root filter
evidence: The main heart-rate list and settings list populate action callbacks with the same function. Its event-user-data getter returns an action ID, used in a 15-case jump table to select a navigation category, with the original ID passed on in the navigation request. Main rows use IDs 0 and 1 for rest and settings; settings rows use 8, 9, 10 and 11 for monitoring, health monitoring, high and low warning rows respectively. Other views also register this callback.
limitations: Changing an ID can navigate to a different screen or trigger other callback side effects, including a helper call for IDs 12 and 13. Out-of-range values still result in a navigation request and are not a safe suppression mechanism. Exact source page is not determined by this hook; close all relevant heart-rate views before installation and ensure system-wide quiescence for the shared getter during publication and rollback. Device behavior unverified.
